newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: IWP says looks forward to year of growth.
newsitem.headline: IWP says looks forward to year of growth.

text.p: Irish industrial holding company IWP International Plc said on Friday that it was looking forward to another year of growth for the enlarged group in 1997.
IWP earlier announced results showing a 3.6 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 22.4 million punts and said it was acquiring an 80 percent stake in Constance Carroll Holdings for 38.5 million sterling.
It also said that it had finalised a $100 million private placement, part of which will be used to fund the acquisition.
"Although it is obviously too early to comment in relation to the enlarged IWP group on the outcome of the current year, your board looks forward to another year of continuing growth," IWP said.
It said because of the size of the acquisition it will require shareholder approval and an extraordinary meeting has been scheduled for July 1, 1997 for this purpose.
Moran said the difficulties that the group overcame in the market place were overshadowed by the strength of the Dutch Guilder "which was outside our control."

"The raising of a $100 million loan and the proposed acquisition of Constance Carroll Holdings, which significantly strengthens our market position, gives added confidence for the future," Moran added.
